[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is in Tuckerton, New Jersey, attributed to AT&T. Wikipedia coverage of Tuckerton describes the town as home to cable landing infrastructure including an underground facility originally built to Cold War specifications for earlier, now decommissioned transatlantic cable systems TAT-3, TAT-4, and TAT-8, several of which were historically operated by AT&T as part of the original transatlantic telephone cable consortiums before AT&T divestiture and the growth of competing carriers. The town is also home to a separate GlobeNet cable landing point, recorded elsewhere in this registry under its own GlobeNet operator entry, and to the decommissioned TAT-14 cable landing facility. Specific dates of AT&T establishment at this address or detailed current operational significance were not found in available sourcing this session. No building specific address, current operational status, or MW figures were located.
